custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active part, part A, and an inactive part, part B, at the test location.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154836-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154836-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • To set a part inactive: on the Inventory page's Active tab click Search, type its part number, click its row; in Edit Inventory Part click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window. The part then shows on the Inactive tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The window is titled "New Inventory Part". A thin line runs under the title row, with the close X at its right end.
  • No status pill shows in the title row.

Step 2:

  • The window closes.

Step 3:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 4:

  • The window is titled "Edit Inventory Part", with a thin line under the title row and a green pill reading "Active" beside the close X.

Step 5:

  • The window closes.

Step 6:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 7:

  • Part B is listed.

Step 8:

  • The title row shows a grey pill reading "Inactive" beside the close X.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog), story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S13-R1: “The dialog is titled "New Inventory Part" when creating a part and "Edit Inventory Part" when editing one.”
  • S13-R2: “The title row has a thin line under it, and the close X at its right end.”
  • S13-R3: “When editing, the title row shows the part's saved status as a pill beside the close X: "Active" in green, or "Inactive" in grey.”
  • S9-R14: “The part dialog of an inactive part shows the grey "Inactive" badge in its title row (S13-R3).”
